analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 구간 횡보, ADX 추세 약화
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range sideways, ADX trend weakening
analysis.reason: 직전 2거래일 상승 후 금일 -2.09% 하락으로 추세 전환 신호 미확인. RSI 52.6으로 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 히스토그램 3.6942로 악화. ADX 19.3으로 추세 약화 구간 진입. 52주 저가 대비 27.7% 위치로 추가 하락 여력 존재.
analysis.reasonEn: After a 2-day rise, today's -2.09% drop failed to confirm a trend reversal. RSI at 52.6 is sideways in neutral territory, and MACD histogram at 3.6942 is worsening. ADX at 19.3 indicates a weakening trend. The price is 27.7% above the 52-week low, suggesting room for further decline.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 48.2로 약세, 주봉 SMA20 360.16 하회 중. 일봉은 중립 구간 횡보.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 48.2 is bearish, and the price is below the weekly SMA20 at 360.16. The daily chart is trading sideways in the neutral zone.

· 현 구간 진단 (하락추세) + 관망 조건: RSI 45 이하 또는 55 이상 회복, MACD 히스토그램 개선 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($346.65) vs SMA5/20/50 ($344.54/$333.24/$343.79): short-term trend above, mid-term trend below diagnosis
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($363.16/$366.94): below long-term trend, maintaining bearish strength
· 52-week position (27.7%) + current price level is high relative to historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.5→52.6) + neutral assessment + downward momentum confirmed
· MACD histogram trajectory (4.0099→3.6942) + worsening diagnosis + no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $333.24) + band width 21.52% at normal levels
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($343.29) + basis (moving average based)
· Swing resistance ($347.61) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x) + moderate confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + conditions for entry/wait-and-see: RSI recovers below 45 or above 55, MACD histogram improvement confirmed
analysis.patternNote: 일봉 차트상 5일 고가/저가와 20일 고가/저가가 좁은 범위에서 횡보하며 뚜렷한 추세 형성 실패. 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 방향 탐색 중.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The daily chart shows sideways movement within a narrow range between the 5-day and 20-day highs/lows, failing to form a clear trend. The price is exploring direction near the Bollinger Band middle line.
keyPoints: RSI 59.5 → 52.6 하락하며 중립 구간 횡보 지속, 매수세 약화 확인
MACD 히스토그램 4.0099 → 3.6942 악화, 하락 압력 유지
ADX 19.3으로 추세 약화 구간 진입, 변동성 확대 가능성
keyPointsEn: RSI decline from 59.5 to 52.6 continues sideways movement in the neutral zone, confirming weakening buying pressure
MACD histogram worsening from 4.0099 to 3.6942, maintaining downward pressure
ADX enters weakening trend zone at 19.3, potential for increased volatility
analysis.riskNote: 주봉 RSI 48.2, 주봉 SMA20 하회 등 장기 추세 약화 신호와 일봉의 횡보 구간이 충돌하며 방향성 부재로 인한 변동성 확대 위험.
analysis.riskNoteEn: Risk of increased volatility due to lack of direction, as the weakening long-term trend signals on the weekly chart (RSI 48.2, below SMA20) conflict with the daily chart's sideways consolidation.
